metadata.subtitle: 询问与介绍职业 What's your …'s job?
metadata.subject: english
metadata.lesson_name: Part A Let's talk: 询问与介绍职业

curriculum_evidence.evidence_summary: 依据人教版PEP英语四年级上册 Unit 1 Part A Let's talk(P4-P5)与电子课本实证知识点;对话与核心词汇取自课本原文。

slides.title: Part A Let's talk
slides.subtitle: What's your …'s job? 询问与介绍职业

slides.title: Learning Goals 学习目标
items: 能用 What's your …'s job? 询问他人的职业
能用 He's / She's a … 介绍职业,认读 doctor, nurse, farmer, office worker, factory worker
说职业时,名词前别忘了冠词 a
slides.notes: Read the goals together. Today we can talk about jobs!

slides.title: Warm-up 热身
items: Greetings: Good morning! How are you today?
Chant: Father, father, what's his job? Teacher, teacher, a teacher, a teacher!
Look and say: 你认识图片里的人是做什么的吗?
slides.notes: 带节奏拍手齐chant,营造氛围。第3条引出"职业"话题,教师做动作学生猜职业。

slides.title: Key Sentence 核心句型
steps: 问: What's your father's job?(你爸爸的职业是什么?)
答: He's a doctor.(他是一名医生。)
换人问: mother → She's a nurse.(注意 He's / She's)
换职业答: a farmer / an office worker
slides.callout: Job questions: What's your …'s job? — He's / She's a …
slides.notes: 教师先示范问答,再让同桌替换人称呼一呼一答。板书时用红笔圈出 a 和 's。

slides.title: Let's talk 听说活动
slides.problem: Listen and answer: What's the mother's job?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Doctors are great! My father is a doctor too.

solution_steps: 听录音,圈出答案 PE teacher
跟读模仿:注意 What's 和 job 的连读
分角色朗读,再交换角色
替换关键词,创编新对话
slides.notes: 两遍录音:第一遍整体听,第二遍逐句跟读。Pair work 时教师巡视,提醒别漏 a。

slides.title: Word Cards 职业词汇
steps: 看词卡,听教师范读,跟读两遍
看中文说英文,再看英文说中文
同桌互考:指卡片,快问快答
slides.notes: High-low voice 开火车读。小游戏:教师说中文,学生抢答英文;再做"指卡片快读"。

slides.title: 易错警示 Don't forget "a"!
slides.reason: 职业名词前漏掉冠词 a:介绍职业时,单数可数名词前要加 a(读职业时字母 a 要发出来)
slides.notes: 让学生齐读错例和正例,感受差别。追问:"She's nurse." 对不对?怎么改?再提醒所有格别漏 's。

slides.title: Practice 课堂练习

items.stem: 选词补全: What's your father's ___?  (job / old)

items.answer: She's a farmer. (职业名词前加 a)

items.stem: 连一连: nurse · doctor · farmer — 医生 · 护士 · 农民
items.answer: nurse-护士; doctor-医生; farmer-农民

items.stem: Pair work 写一写:用 What's your …'s job? 和同桌创编两句问答并写下来。
items.answer: 略:示例 What's your mother's job? — She's a nurse. 要求句中有 a、所有格 's 不漏。

slides.notes: 限时6分钟。第2题请学生上讲台改错并说理由;第4题请两组展示,师生共同评价 a 与 's。

slides.title: Self-check 小结自评
items: I can ask about people's jobs. 我会问职业
I can say five jobs. 我会说五种职业
I can use "a" before jobs. 我会正确使用冠词 a
slides.notes: 学生逐条自评:能做到的举绿牌,还不熟练的举黄牌。教师记录黄牌人数,课后跟进。

slides.title: Board Design 板书设计
slides.content:
Unit 1  Part A  Let's talk
What's your …'s job? — He's / She's a doctor.
Jobs: doctor  nurse  farmer  office worker  factory worker
⚠ Don't forget "a"!  ⚠ all格别漏 's
slides.notes: 左栏句型,右栏词库,下方易错警示;红色粉笔标 a 与 's。

slides.title: Homework 作业
items: 听读 Let's talk 录音3遍,模仿语音语调
用 What's your …'s job? 问一问家人的职业,记下来
抄写5个职业词各2遍,别忘了冠词 a
slides.notes: 第2项明天课前分享;基础弱的学生只完成前两项。

slides.message: Goodbye, class! See you next time!
